text:
hannah: billing pinged about project traffic being billed to org during last night's router churn. saw several minutes where project attributes collapsed to org-only.
jose: which router change? any deploy notes?
hannah: auth-gateway v4.6 rolled 2026-01-18T02:10Z. window 02:13-02:18Z. edge logs show `x-origin: org/1212` but `x-inbound-origin` was `org/1212/project/3/sa/worker`
ian: that's the new collapse-on-introspect-failure behavior we merged to avoid noisy 403s. understood the safety tradeoff but didn't fully map billing impact.
ops-bot: auth-gateway v4.6 deployed 2026-01-18T02:09Z -> rollout 100% 02:12Z.
billing: org/1212 token usage +10% vs project/3 -10%. accounts flagged it.
jose: immediate mitigations: 1) revert collapse (risky), 2) preserve original origin header but mark "uncertain", 3) preserve signed original header for telemetry only.
hannah: vote for preserve+uncertain flag. preserve header for billing/alerts but downstream auth must ignore unless signature present. add telemetry tag `auth.origin_resolution=collapsed_introspect_fail_preserved`
ian: implementation: add `x-origin-preserved: <orig>` and `x-origin-asserted: true|false`. sign preserved header with proxy HMAC key. verification only allowed from trusted CIDRs or signed header.
jose: UX: Console needs per-account toggle "enforce asserted project attribution" that rejects uncertain attribution (403) and a badge on project pages: "attribution uncertain (n)" linking to sample traces. devex, can you scope?
devex: yes. add metric `attribution_uncertain_count` to traffic table and filter by `auth.origin_resolution`. badge + trace links are small; we can ship in a week.
billing: policy: bill to most-specific asserted identity. if asserted=false, bill to org by default but increment `billing.attribution_uncertain` and mark invoices for manual review. no auto-adjusts.
hannah: quota note: if attribution uncertain, do NOT apply project-level rate credits; instead enforce org-level caps. otherwise traffic could bypass project quotas.
ian: add a gate in rate-limiter: if `x-origin-asserted=false` then evaluate quotas at org scope only and emit `quota.enforced_scope=org_unasserted`.
jose: security: ensure preserved header cannot be spoofed. only accept signed preserved headers or ones from internal CIDR. key rotation plan and signature verification library required.
devex: console flag for Dedicated customers: "strict billing attribution" to deny fallback and return 403 when attribution uncertain. default behavior tolerant with preserved header.
ops-bot: quick rollout checklist created: small patch -> unit tests -> staging smoke -> 5% canary -> monitor `billing.attribution_uncertain` and token-breakdown dashboards -> full rollout.
hannah: backfill: run a job to enumerate affected requests in the 02:13-02:18Z window and produce a report for finance/support. billing, can you coordinate notices if we find nontrivial impact?
billing: yes, we'll run backfill and prepare account outreach.
ian: I'll open a small PR tonight adding the headers, telemetry enum, and quota gate. will include tests ensuring unsigned preserved headers are ignored for auth decisions.
jose: add integration test simulating introspect 5xx and verifying preserved signed header + telemetry + quota behavior.
devex: I'll sketch console changes and API to expose the uncertain counts.
hannah: also add an observability alert: if `billing.attribution_uncertain` spikes > threshold, auto-create incident and page on-call.
ops-bot: alert rule template created.
jose: ok good plan. ping infra for CIDR list and HMAC key rotation window. will tag security for review.
hannah: thanks all. keeping thread open for PR link and backfill results. :thumbsup:
